mentions.name: Snowboard Kids 2 Decompilation (snowboardkids2-decomp)
mentions.description: A matching decompilation of the Nintendo 64 game Snowboard Kids 2, built from scratch as a first decompilation project. Accompanying blog posts document the experience, including using coding agents and one-shot decompilation with Claude to decompile N64 games.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://github.com/cdlewis/snowboardkids2-decomp

A matching decompilation of snowboard kids 2 for the n64. Why this game? Well it's awesome but also I wanted to work on a decomp project from scratch.
